note: Managed by port/scripts/retention.py. Paths are repo-relative. Only files listed under firmware_versions are ever deleted.

M1-baseline.reason: Flashable test128 image before M1 (C07 init, kept seed); restores test128 only (CID-locked bootstrap)

M1.reason: Flashable M1 image: rcS/rcK init, UI autostart, seedless; works on any card >= 2 GiB

M2.reason: Flashable M2 image: sleep/resume, battery, headphones, writable cpufreq, NES core

M3a.1.reason: Built M3a.1 firmware: M3a + SDL2 rebuilt with its pipewire driver (sound fix); T2-verified, written to test128 p2

M3b.reason: Built M3b firmware: boot-records U-Boot, M3b kernel (HW_RANDOM_ROCKCHIP) main + M2 kernel previous; T2 pending

keep.build/phase4/private: SSH client key, known_hosts, Wi-Fi/credential backups (private)
keep.build/phase4/p2-initial: Applied migration receipts, independent copy and consumed-attempt fences
keep.dist/phase4: Frozen sanitized evidence and license archives; not a set of firmware builds
keep.dist/recovery: Flashable recovery images (private: Wi-Fi PSK, SSH keys)
keep.build/recovery: Latest device capture used to compose the recovery images
